name: ui-drawer
description: Bootstrap drawer (sidebar panel) on the native <dialog>: placements, static backdrop, body scrolling, responsive docking, sheet, translucent, swipe to close.

descriptions.--bs-drawer-inset: Space between the panel and the viewport edges.
descriptions.--bs-drawer-zindex: Stacking order of a non-modal drawer.
descriptions.--bs-drawer-padding-x: Horizontal padding of header, body and footer.
descriptions.--bs-drawer-padding-y: Vertical padding of header, body and footer.
descriptions.--bs-drawer-backdrop-blur: Blur of the page behind the backdrop.
descriptions.--bs-drawer-sheet-width: Maximum width of a sheet from lg on (unset: 760px).
